about: Menus served to the app at GET /v1/content/menus: named sets of 3-7 recipes with a short intro. 'kind' is weekly, occasion or mood. 'recipes' lists recipe ids from the app's library (ios/RefrigeratorRecipes/Resources/SampleRecipes.json) or the recipe packs (recipe-packs.json); a recipe in neither goes in full, with its own id, under the menu's 'recipeDetails'. Optional: 'slot' (dinner by default, or lunch) is the meal the app plans; 'Add all to plan' spreads the recipes tagged for that meal over the week and puts sides and desserts with the first, while an occasion is planned as one meal on a day the user picks; 'mood' is a mood tag id; 'window' {from, to} shows the menu on Tonight while in season, as full dates (YYYY-MM-DD, for holidays that move) or yearly ones (MM-DD, may wrap the new year); 'draft': true keeps a menu out of the app until someone who cooks that food has reviewed it. 'rotation' is the weekly order of 'This week's menu'. Copy describes dishes many families make, never 'the' menu for a tradition. See server/README.md.

recipeDetails.title: Herb-Roasted Turkey Breast
recipeDetails.summary: A boneless turkey breast roasted under garlic-herb butter, juicy and ready in about an hour and a half, mostly in the oven. Plenty for six, without a whole bird.

ingredients.name: Rosemary
ingredients.note: fresh, finely chopped, or 1 tsp dried

instructions: Heat the oven to 400°F. Pat the turkey dry and let it sit out while the oven heats.
Mash the butter with the garlic, thyme, rosemary, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Loosen the skin with your fingers and rub half the butter underneath it, then the rest over the top. Set the turkey in a roasting pan or ovenproof skillet and pour the broth around it.
Roast 55 to 70 minutes, basting with the pan juices twice, until the thickest part reads 160°F on an instant-read thermometer.
Rest it 15 minutes under loose foil; it will rise to about 165°F. Slice across the grain and spoon the pan juices over, with a squeeze of lemon.
